content.short: Openfort is an open-source wallet-as-a-service platform offering embedded (in-app) and cross-app wallets.
content.description: Openfort delivers wallet-as-a-service with both embedded (in-app) and global (cross-app) wallets. It consolidates authentication, account abstraction, gas sponsorship, and orchestration, so teams can avoid juggling multiple vendors. Supported chains include Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Tron, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Polkadot, BNB Chain, Celo, Harmony, and Bitcoin, with enterprise-focused readiness for scalable deployments across organizations.

resources.title: Agent Wallet Identity, Permissions, and Compliance
resources.tldr: Three questions decide whether an agent can be trusted with money: who it acts as, what it is allowed to do, and what you can prove afterwards. Treats all three as engineering problems.

resources.title: Server-Side Wallets: An API Guide for Automated Payouts
resources.tldr: Batched payouts and treasury operations need keys that live somewhere defensible. Covers holding them in a TEE with policy enforcement, rather than in an environment variable.

resources.title: Best AI Agent Wallets for Developers, Compared
resources.tldr: Compares agent wallets on payment rails (x402, AP2, MCP) and spending controls. Long, and more concerned with what happens when an agent misbehaves than with feature counts.
